import_torchvision_model_to_graph: use TorchGraphImporter to import a torchvision model like AlexNet into a graph using aotautograd method
test_model_inference_graph_import: run graph import tests on a torchvision model in eval mode using fx, aotautograd, functorch, and acc_tracer methods
test_model_training_graph_import: run graph import tests on a torchvision model in train mode with requires_grad inputs using aotautograd
check_graph_consistency: call check_consistency on an imported graph to verify the TorchGraphImporter produced a valid graph representation
import_model_with_optimizer: import a torchvision model in train mode with an optimizer enabled using TorchGraphImporter and aotautograd method
